articles.title: Companies promised AI gains— here's how the payoff showed up in earnings
articles.summary: Some companies are beginning to report financial benefits from artificial intelligence investments, as interest in the technology shifts from hype to measurable returns in the latest quarter. Corporate AI investment has surged as companies look to boost efficiency and become more profitable, reaching $581.7 billion in 2025, up 130% from the previous year, according to the Stanford HAI 2026 AI Index report.

articles.title: OpenAI pares fundraising goal, now seeking up to $20 billion in latest round
articles.summary: OpenAI is seeking to raise up to $20 billion in a new funding round, CNBC confirmed on Saturday, paring back its earlier target of up to $30 billion. News that the ChatGPT developer slashed its funding round follows a week when investors asked whether big tech firms' spending on AI, especially to build out data centers and snap up GPUs, will deliver adequate returns.

articles.title: SpaceX loses bid to toss NAACP lawsuit over Memphis data center air pollution
articles.summary: SpaceX's AI division, SpaceXAI, lost its bid to dismiss an NAACP lawsuit, which is proceeding in federal court in Mississippi, according to a judge's opinion released late Friday. The lawsuit claims that the AI division of CEO Elon Musk's aerospace and defense tech conglomerate violated the Clean Air Act by using gas-fired combustion turbines to power its massive AI data centers in Greater Memphis.
